blocks.text: ADELANTO, Calif. — Protesters gathered Friday at the Adelanto ICE Processing Center to advocate for the freedom of Filipino singer Mark Mabasa, whose immigration proceedings were pushed back to November 5. Held at the Southern California facility since September 21, the 40-year-old son of assassinated Philippine broadcaster Percival “Percy Lapid” Mabasa faces undisclosed reasons for his detention by US Immigration and Customs Enforcement. His hearing had been scheduled for Friday, Oct. 2, but advocates and members of his family said it was rescheduled for Nov. 5, extending his detention at the Adelanto facility for at least another month.
